artContract.purpose: Single catalog of art tasks and technical parameters. spriteReady marks an existing PNG; animations.<clip>.ready — a finished clip. The engine does not request planned images.
artContract.packing: Character: one PNG per model containing all clips, 8 columns; clip rows are defined by animations. Static: one image. Dynamic: one column, frames from top to bottom. Separate PNGs per clip are not needed.
artContract.metadata: Technical fields frameWidth, frameHeight, frames, anchor, scale, hash and animations.start/frames/fps/loop are stored directly in the catalog entry. There are no other manifests.
artContract.variants: Clothing, walls, roofs and flags use palette variants; do not duplicate full sets for every town. A different silhouette requires a separate model.
artContract.integration: The engine supports character atlases, static and dynamic environment sprites, and modular buildings. Ready entries use the shared loading queue and cache.
artContract.optional: optional:true on a clip marks a future reserve not currently required by game behavior.
artContract.animationIntegration: Finished standard clips are selected automatically: idle/walk/run, attack and attack_<weapon>, death, stunned, swim, ride, draw_weapon/sheath, work/work_knife. Additional profession states are linked through states. Models are selected automatically by role ID, gameRoles or gameRaces; no separate engine registration is required.

idle.description: Calm stationary pose.

walk.description: Walking in place without root movement.

stunned.description: Loses orientation and struggles to balance while stunned.

sheath.description: Sheathes a sword; the reverse action draw_weapon.

work_knife.description: Works with a knife in front of the body; a manual-work variant for butchering.

catalog.notes: Interchangeable melee weapons: sword, axe, hammer; ranged weapons: bow and Arctarian device. Protective clothing and a mounted pose are required.

catalog.name: Dawn Shard
catalog.description: Static. A dark plate with no hammer marks. A thin rainbow rests on its chipped edge; in sunlight it seems deeper than the stone itself. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Moon Seal
catalog.description: Static. A round object marked by three grooves. A warm palm leaves a pale imprint that takes time to fade. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Heart of the Tide
catalog.description: Static. A small, heavy block. Place it on a table, and water droplets slowly gather along one edge. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Blind Eye
catalog.description: Static. A dark slit turns inside cloudy glass, though nothing outside moves. A small bell sounds duller when held near it. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Endless Thread
catalog.description: Static. A spool of almost invisible thread. No end can be found; your fingers feel its pull long after touching it. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Mirror Garden Seed
catalog.description: Static. A smooth seed beneath a transparent crust. Thin branches reflect across its surface, even in an empty room. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Wind Knot
catalog.description: Static. Several nested rings that never touch. Nearby sand forms ridges across the wind. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Vessel of Alien Breath
catalog.description: Static. A sealed vessel with a violet rim. Its empty interior sometimes arranges itself into regular layers. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Crown of the Empty Door
catalog.description: Static. A broken arc with smooth teeth along its inner edge. Looking down its length, distant objects briefly slip out of alignment with their outlines. Do not add labels or obvious modern interfaces; a separate object for chests, pedestals and discoveries.

catalog.name: Evening Sunbeam
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Rows of black rectangles rise from the water. Each reflects sunlight at the same angle. Fishers steer their nets around them.

catalog.name: Cold Roots
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Straight ribs stretch underwater beside the cathedral shore. Warm silt never collects on the surrounding stones.

catalog.name: Uarelon Tree
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. A crooked pine clings to bare stone. The fence reads: ”Be like the Uarelon Tree.” Nobody remembers who brought its seed.

catalog.name: Edge of the Old Road
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. A smooth black strip ends inside the cliff. Identical white dashes disappear beneath roots; the masons know no such stonework.

catalog.name: Silk Road
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. A dense pale canopy hangs between the rocks. Its threads reach trees far beyond the gorge. Something deep inside shifts its supports.

catalog.name: Garden of Stone Honeycombs
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Empty cradles are coated with the same film. Toothed leaves sprout from some; others hold bones with remarkably similar curves.

catalog.name: Mark of the Closed Eye
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. On a chipped slab, five rays cross out an eye. The mark is older than the wooden chapel above it. People bring flowers, but nobody reads its letters.

catalog.name: Upper Ledge
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Purple air pools below the stone boundary like water. Huge eyeless hosts point to your chest, then to a sealed shell. Their gestures hold no threat.

catalog.name: Circles Beneath the Mist
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. The artisan’s broad arms end in different tools. They remove one and fit another in the same motion. Waste from one workbench is collected for the next.

catalog.name: Half the Sky
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. A semicircular hull hangs above the basin. Dust trembles underneath, but there are no chains or flames. Half of a similar shell serves as a roof.

catalog.name: Blue Rest
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Tall riders wear face wraps, even beside the fire. Small winged attendants mend their straps, while only the wingless carry weapons.

catalog.name: Teraquar Barrier
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. The old barrier has handrails at two heights: very low and above a human head. Narrow walkways suit those who do not travel on the ground.

catalog.name: Empty Frame
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Two broad arches stand without gates or hinges. The stone on one side is cut so smoothly that the skyline appears in its reflection. Sometimes the air between the arches differs from the air beyond them.

catalog.name: Pale Shore
catalog.description: Static, recognizable lore landmark. Abandoned bowls line the stream. A house wall bears marks of children’s heights, all low. The doors show no claw marks, only bolts on the inside.

buildingAssemblyContract.coordinates: rect is [x,y,width,height] in fractions of the generated building footprint; PNG anchor normalized, default [0,0]; door origin is its tile top-left, rect is in tiles
buildingAssemblyContract.adaptation: stretch whole modules to footprint; use separate contour variants; no repetition or automatic clipping
buildingAssemblyContract.readiness: each component spriteReady; assembly switches atomically when all required visible modules are loaded; top-level spriteReady means all required modules for all variants are exported
